response.query: Which LA-Sn standards, homogeneity tests, and ablation parameters (spot size, fluence) are required to align LA-Sn with solution double-spike accuracy?
response.answer: To align LA-Sn with solution double-spike accuracy, use LA-ICPMS with spot size ≤ 10 µm and fluence ≤ 1 J/cm². Ensure homogeneity tests confirm uniform spike distribution. Follow standards from relevant conferences and journals.
